name: tide-diviner-enter-level-two-looks-three-takes-deep-card-rest-to-graveyard
notes: Tide Diviner (zrBBvgIvt6) with a level-2 champion looks at the top 3 cards: the third goes to hand, the first two to the graveyard, and a marker sits below them. Pre-fix only the top card was ever looked at.

rulesClauses: On Enter: Look at the top 1+LV cards of your deck. Put one of those cards into your hand and the rest into your graveyard.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. The generated enterAbilities["zrBBvgIvt6:0"] body looked at the top 1+LV cards with a loop of MZMove($player, "myDeck-0", "myTempZone"): Remove() only flags a slot removed (no splice), so "myDeck-0" re-resolved to the SAME removed slot after the first and MZMove's already-removed guard silently no-oped -- only the top card was ever looked at at any champion level (nothing went to the graveyard and the player never got a choice). The generated file cannot be edited (gitignored), so the closure is overridden in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php with MZMoveTopOfZone().
